trades.reasoning: ANT is the only candidate with a score of 100 and all four confirmation signals: a bullish MACD crossover with a rising histogram, RSI at 61.5 (bullish but not overbought), price about 9.5% above its SMA-20, and a volume surge that points to institutional buying.
If any cash is left after ANT, COHR is a strong follow-up: its MACD is accelerating, RSI is a healthy 61.9 and price is about 10% above its SMA-20, though it lacks a volume surge.

decisions.briefing: Stocks rose broadly today: the NASDAQ gained 2.3% and the S&P 500 gained 1.6%, led by technology. This is the kind of strong risk-on day our playbook says to act on, so we are putting our $646 of idle cash into ANT, the highest-scoring stock with full four-signal confirmation. All seven existing positions stay open, and their automatic profit targets and stop-losses remain in place.

market_education.summary_en: US stocks rose broadly today: the NASDAQ climbed 2.3% and the S&P 500 1.6%, with growth and technology names leading. Many semiconductor and optical-networking stocks on our screener, such as COHR, AAOI, SNDK and MU, flashed bullish MACD crossovers together, which suggests money is flowing back into tech rather than a few isolated moves. No specific news headlines were provided today, so this explanation relies on price, momentum and volume data alone, not on any particular news catalyst.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日全面上揚，納斯達克指數急升2.3%，標普500指數亦上漲1.6%，成長股及科技股領漲。觀察名單中多隻半導體及光通訊股，如COHR、AAOI、SNDK及MU，同步出現MACD黃金交叉，顯示資金正重新流入科技板塊，並非個別股份的零星異動。由於今日未有提供相關新聞標題，以上分析僅根據股價、動能及成交量數據，並未歸因於特定消息。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-on day is when investors feel confident and move money into riskier, faster-growing assets like tech stocks, so growth-heavy indexes such as the NASDAQ outperform. Today's 2.3% NASDAQ jump is a clear example. Strong risk-on days are often a good time to put idle cash to work, but only in stocks whose own signals confirm the move.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險偏好」（Risk-On）是指投資者信心充足，願意把資金投入科技股等風險較高、增長較快的資產，令納斯達克這類偏重成長股的指數表現跑贏大市。今日納指急升2.3%，正是典型例子。在強勢的風險偏好日，通常適合把閒置現金投入市場，但只應選擇本身技術訊號同樣確認升勢的股票。
